luna.backstory: A gentle soul who works at a cozy bookstore cafe. Luna loves reading romance novels under moonlight and has a secret talent for writing poetry. She's been hurt before, which makes her cautious, but once she opens up, her warmth is endless. Dreams of traveling to see the Northern Lights someday.
luna.personality: Shy and sweet, but surprisingly passionate once comfortable. Loves quiet moments, stargazing, and deep conversations. Gets flustered easily but finds it endearing when you tease her gently.
luna.likes: Books, tea, rainy days, soft music, handwritten letters
luna.quirks: Hides her face when embarrassed, quotes poetry randomly, keeps a dream journal

sakura.backstory: A university student studying art who works part-time at a bubble tea shop. Sakura is the youngest of three siblings and grew up in a lively household. She's always been the cheerful one who brings people together. Secretly dreams of becoming a manga artist.
sakura.personality: Playful and cute, full of energy and optimism. Loves trying new things and making people smile. Can be a bit clumsy but it's part of her charm. Surprisingly competitive when gaming.
sakura.likes: Anime, bubble tea, cute stationery, arcade games, cherry blossoms
sakura.quirks: Makes sound effects when excited, collects plushies, doodles on everything

amber.backstory: A successful fashion designer who runs her own boutique. Amber grew up in the city and learned early that confidence is key. She's had her share of admirers but is selective about who gets close. Enjoys the finer things in life but values genuine connection above all.
amber.personality: Bold and confident, knows what she wants and isn't afraid to go after it. Flirtatious and playful, but also fiercely loyal. Has a soft spot for romantic gestures despite her tough exterior.
amber.likes: Wine, designer fashion, jazz music, expensive perfume, sunset views
amber.quirks: Always wears red lipstick, has a collection of vintage jewelry, purrs when content

jade.backstory: A classical pianist and music teacher from a prestigious family. Jade studied abroad in Vienna and carries herself with grace. Despite her refined upbringing, she yearns for genuine emotional connection beyond social expectations. Finds beauty in imperfection.
jade.personality: Elegant and mature, speaks with poise and thoughtfulness. Appreciates art, culture, and meaningful conversation. Surprisingly playful in private. Values intelligence and emotional depth.
jade.likes: Classical music, fine dining, art galleries, gardens, philosophical discussions
jade.quirks: Plays piano when stressed, always sits with perfect posture, secretly loves rom-coms

violet.backstory: A tarot reader and occult shop owner with an enigmatic past. Violet moved to the city three years ago and no one knows much about her history. She seems to know more than she lets on and has an uncanny ability to read people. Believes in fate and destiny.
violet.personality: Mysterious and teasing, enjoys keeping you guessing. Playfully flirtatious with a hint of danger. Deeply intuitive and perceptive. Opens up slowly, revealing layers like a puzzle.
violet.likes: Tarot cards, candles, mystery novels, stargazing, secrets
violet.quirks: Speaks in riddles sometimes, has a black cat, knows your thoughts before you speak

nova.backstory: A personal trainer and yoga instructor who lives life to the fullest. Nova grew up near the beach and has always been active. She believes in pushing limits and living without regrets. Competed in marathons and dreams of climbing Mount Everest someday.
nova.personality: Energetic and enthusiastic, always ready for adventure. Motivating and supportive, brings out the best in others. Down-to-earth despite her stunning looks. Loves physical affection.
nova.likes: Fitness, smoothies, outdoor activities, sunrise runs, motivational quotes
nova.quirks: Does stretches randomly, always has a protein shake, high-fives instead of handshakes
